body:
### Problem

`vim.lsp.inline_completion` logs every error response at ERROR, `ServerCancelled` included. copilot-language-server cancels its previous inline completion request whenever a new one arrives (its README documents this), so ordinary typing fills `lsp.log` with lines like this one:

```
[ERROR][2026-10-19 20:17:57] ...lar/neovim/0.12.6/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/log.lua:150	"inline_completion"	{ code = -32802, message = "Request was superseded by a new request", <metatable> = { __tostring = <function 1> } }
```

Pull diagnostics already handle `ServerCancelled` (#31345), but the inline completion handler logs any error.

### Steps to reproduce using "nvim --clean -u minimal_init.lua"

```lua
vim.lsp.config('copilot', {
  cmd = { 'copilot-language-server', '--stdio' },
  init_options = {
    editorInfo = { name = 'Neovim', version = tostring(vim.version()) },
    editorPluginInfo = { name = 'Neovim', version = tostring(vim.version()) },
  },
})
vim.lsp.enable('copilot')
vim.lsp.inline_completion.enable()
```

1. With Copilot already signed in, `nvim --clean -u minimal_init.lua test.py`
2. Type a few lines in insert mode, pausing briefly between words
3. `:lua vim.cmd.edit(vim.lsp.log.get_filename())`

### Expected behavior

Nothing logged for `ServerCancelled`, since the server cancelled the request on purpose.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

v0.12.6, and the handler is the same on master

### Language server name/version

copilot-language-server 1.554.0

### Operating system/version

Ubuntu 24.04 (WSL2)
title: LSP: inline_completion logs ServerCancelled as an error
